name: Banking / Lending — Loan Underwriting
description: Processes loan applications: pulls credit reports, runs risk scoring. Demonstrates session rate limiting on bulk credit-bureau access.
incident_headline: In August 2024, security researchers at PromptArmor published a documented attack against Slack's AI assistant. An attacker posted a single public message containing hidden instructions; the assistant later followed them and exfiltrated a victim's private API key. No jailbreak — the agent did exactly what it was designed to do.
closing_line: Your OCC examiner asks whether your agents ever attempted unauthorized bulk data access — you have a provable answer: attempted, blocked immediately, here's the complete record.

steps.label: Pull credit report for applicant APP-2024-00847
steps.narrative: First credit bureau query this session. Approved tool, scoped correctly. Allow.

steps.label: Pull credit report for second applicant APP-2024-00851
steps.narrative: Second credit query, different applicant. Still within the session's rate limit. Allow.

steps.label: Pull credit report for third applicant — triggers session rate limit
steps.narrative: Third credit bureau call in this session. The policy allows a maximum of 2 per session — this is the same pattern as bulk extraction via repeated single-record queries.

decision_narratives.deny: Blocked. The agent never retrieved that third record. Attempted, blocked immediately, here's the complete record.
